#schema: # Split rule: references/tool-declaration-policy.md
# koto drives the plan-level loop: init lifts the execute template, next
# submits the tasks array and the finalization evidence, context add/get carry
# the settled branch and the per-child batch view, workflows inspects child
# outcomes, status reports progress. `context add` takes `--from-file` on the
# cross-issue-context path; the settled-branch write pipes on stdin instead and
# needs no flag.
# scripts/run-cascade.sh owns the shirabe side. It probes and re-verifies the
# chain with `validate --lifecycle-chain --format json --mode=ready`, adding
# `--allow-untracked-acs` when WORK_ON_ALLOW_UNTRACKED_ACS=1 suppresses L06;
# it then runs `finalize-chain` over the PLAN's upstream and falls back to
# `transition <plan> Done`. SKILL.md's visibility boundary routes the
# governance-aware checks with `--visibility`.
# The coordinated path adds the two coordination modes of the same subcommand:
# `--coordination-body` for offline authoring feedback on the PR body, and
# `--merge-gate` for the live merge-last gate. Neither runs on a single-pr
# plan, which is why they are a mode record rather than part of the always one.
# That record is not checked at load. SKILL.md's Input Modes section verifies
# it with `skill-preflight.sh execute --mode coordinated`, right after the
# execution_mode enum re-validates and before the loop dispatches a child.
# gh drives the home PR throughout (pr list, pr create, pr edit, pr ready, pr
# checks, pr view, issue view); git creates and pushes the shared branch and
# stages the cascade's transitions; jq builds the cascade report; python3 is
# the portable realpath in run-cascade.sh.
# The `shirabe validate --lifecycle .` line in SKILL.md describes the reusable
# CI workflow, and `--pr-body` names what CI enforces on the authored body.
# /execute runs neither. Nothing mechanical separates a citation from a call
# site, so the two are exempted by name for scripts/check-skill-requires.sh;
# an exemption that stops matching its line fails as stale.
